🔔 Morning Brief — What You Need to Know Before the Open

Markets & Futures

S&P +0.6%, NASDAQ +0.8%, DOW +0.5%
VIX down ~5% to roughly 20 — fear is easing but still elevated
Wednesday's ceasefire rally holding, but follow-through is cautious

Macro Backdrop

10-year yield at ~4.26%, 2-year at 3.78% (48 bps spread)
~25% probability of a rate cut by year-end now priced in
Fed March minutes: policymakers still open to hikes if inflation exceeds 2%
Oil near $100/barrel throws a wrench into the soft landing narrative

Energy & Geopolitics

Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed — only a handful of ships got through since the ceasefire, no oil tankers
Iran charging $1M+ per vessel for passage
WTI crude up ~1-2% pre-market to roughly $98.50
Philippines declared a national energy emergency on March 24 — oil reserves dropped from 57 to 45 days of supply as a country that imports 98% of its oil from the Middle East
The $4 billion MTerra Solar project north of Manila — already under construction since late 2024 — has begun exporting 85 MW to the grid. When fully completed, its 3,500 MWp of solar capacity will make it the world's largest integrated solar-plus-storage facility
South Korea sending a special envoy to Tehran for its 26 stranded vessels

Amazon / Jassy Letter

$200 billion in capex committed for 2026
AWS AI revenue hit a $15 billion annual run rate
Custom chip business (Graviton, Trainium, Nitro) generating $20B+/year at triple-digit growth
Trainium 2 largely sold out, Trainium 3 nearly fully subscribed, Trainium 4 being reserved 18 months early
Stock closed up 5.6% on the letter

Tubi / Streaming

First major streamer to launch a native app inside ChatGPT
100M+ monthly active users, crossed $1B in annual revenue, turned profitable in 2025
Free ad-supported model competing for younger viewers' attention with AI-powered discovery instead of premium content

Washington Political Drama

Democrats pushing War Powers Act vote when Congress reconvenes
70+ lawmakers have called for Trump's removal via impeachment or 25th Amendment
Notable crossover: former congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene, Tucker Carlson, and Alex Jones joined the calls

What to Watch This Weekend

US-Iran talks begin Saturday in Islamabad led by VP Vance — first direct negotiations since the war began
If WTI breaks and holds above $100, the inflation narrative changes completely
Defense stocks and energy names volatile in both directions

Wednesday's ceasefire euphoria was premature. Markets are recalibrating to a conflict that could drag on for months. The Islamabad talks are the next real inflection point.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY | 10042026 | #TWINCITIES
Due to the arrival of foreign delegations, a comprehensive traffic management and diversion plan has been implemented across Islamabad for 11–12 April 2026, with time-based restrictions at multiple locations and strict monitoring to regulate movement and ensure security arrangements. Entry and exit to the Red Zone remains fully closed for general traffic, while heavy vehicle movement is also restricted across the city, resulting in controlled flow and intermittent diversions on major routes. Severe traffic congestion, extended travel delays, intercity movement disruptions, closure of Red Zone access routes, and suspension of heavy vehicle entry across Islamabad during the mentioned period. It is advised to avoid non-essential travel and plan journeys in advance, expecting significant delays, strictly follow diversions and on-ground instructions, and stay updated through official traffic advisories.
#AffectedRoutes: 
GT Road (Peshawar to Rawalpindi), F-6, G-6, G-5 sectors and Margalla Road routes toward Rawalpindi, Faisal Avenue toward Zero Point, Bhara Kahu toward Rawalpindi, Rawalpindi–Islamabad routes via Saddar, Murree Road, 9th Avenue, Zero Point to Korang Chowk section of Islamabad Expressway, Colonel Sher Khan Road to Faizabad, and major intercity highway including Peshawar, Lahore, Taxila Motorway, Chakri, Chak Beli Road, Tarnol, and Fateh Jang Motorway corridors.
#AlternativeRoutes: 
Taxila Motorway, Chakri Road, Chak Beli Road, Rawat corridor, Ring Road routes, Bani Gala route, Taramri Road, 9th Avenue alternative links, Stadium Road, and Tarnol Motorway connections are advised, where accessible, to bypass restricted and congested areas.
#IslamabadTraffic #SecurityAlert #VIPMovement #TravelAdvisory #RoadClosure

data.text:
✝️ God is FUNNY & AWESOME!

✅ You’ll see exactly why after reading this story…

START HERE ⬇️
It was late afternoon yesterday around 5:15pm. My wife and I were driving to Costco for our weekly shopping.

Given our jobs in the hospitality business here in Nevada, she was expressing some real fear about our monthly income (especially after how rough the last two weeks had been).

My instant response when she finished?

ME (100% conviction): “God will provide…”

MY WIFE (skeptical voice): “Well… if this, this, and this happens again like the last two weeks… how will God provide then?”

ME (still 100% conviction): “God will provide, and He will always show us the way…”

MY WIFE (annoyed voice): “Yeah… OK… moving on!”

📝 SIDE NOTE: Imagine the exact face someone makes when they’re thinking, “Yeah… whatever… you’re insane, but I’m done talking about this.”
 That’s the look I got. So I just gave it all to God right then.

And then… something AMAZING happened.

We stopped at the next traffic light before pulling into the Costco lot… and right in front of us appeared a car with THIS license plate 

——🐟—— WWJDRN ——————

I started giggling, tapped her leg, pointed and said:
 “LOOK!” (Pause) “What Would Jesus Do Right Now?!”

I burst out laughing 😆 and added:
 “God will provide!” 🙂

She kind of brushed it off like it was just a coincidence.
 I just sat there smiling while saying in my head…
 “Thank you Jesus” 🙂

To be honest…

I really think in that moment my wife couldn’t believe how perfectly it all lined up, but you and I BOTH know God made it happen for a reason! 😆✝️

The way God continually reveals Himself to me in these little (and big) ways every single month never ceases to amaze me.

Even though my wife was born and raised in the Philippines as a Cradle Catholic, and went to Catholic school…she has always told me:
 “To see is to believe.”

NO LIE.

And then THIS happened yesterday.

Later that evening, we talked about it, but it still seemed like she didn’t fully grasp how powerful the whole chain of events was.

I just keep loving her and giving her grace.

The same grace God keeps giving her.

IN CLOSING…please read this carefully:

I need you to pray for my wife.

I need you to pray that:

1-God softens her heart the same way He has softened and transformed mine in the last 6+ months after Charlie’s assassination.

2-God intervenes and fully opens her up to the overflowing mercy, forgiveness, grace, and love He has for her.

3-God opens her eyes completely while she witnesses the continual transformation happening in me.

4-God creates more opportunities just like yesterday so her own personal transformation to loving Jesus can begin.

Her heart is still very hard…BUT I know God can work a miracle with her in His perfect timing.

This is my prayer right now:
“Jesus, please reveal Yourself to my wife in a way she knows 100% it’s You.
 Soften her heart with the overflowing abundant love, mercy, and grace You have for both of us…here on earth, and one day in heaven.
 May Your will be done as we move forward.

Continue showing me the path, so I can bring all the glory to You and Your kingdom.
 In Jesus’ name I pray…AMEN!”

If you can take a moment right now to pray for her (and for us) exactly like this, I would sincerely appreciate it from the bottom of my heart.

AND…

If you made it this far, thank you.
 I pray God blesses you and your life in exactly the way you need it most right now.

I really mean that.

Please share this story with someone who needs to hear it.

Make it a great day, and never forget…

JESUS LOVES YOU ✝️
